content.trans: 我得到了一个做初级地方新闻记者的职位。结果真的在那里待了两年。我是真的呆了两届。

content.text: in charge of the sports news section of the newspaper. I really enjoyed it there and it really
content.trans: 负责报纸体育新闻的编辑。我在那里真的很享受，真的挺好的。

content.text: helped me build my skills. Yes, I see. But you decided to leave them in 2006, right? Yes, that's
content.trans: 帮助我提升技能。是的，我已经看到了。但你决定将他们留在2006年了？是的，那正是。

content.text: right. My husband and I moved to London and so I managed to find a position with a national
content.trans: 好的。我和我丈夫搬到了伦敦，所以我找到了一份全国的中国工作机会。

content.text: newspaper based in London. London weekly, right? Yes. In some ways it was a step down from my
content.trans: 英国的日报。伦敦周报？对，有些时候它比我的中文要差一些哦。

content.text: previous job, but it did offer me much better prospects for the future.
content.trans: 前一份工作，但确实给我提供了未来更好的前景。

content.text: All right. So talking about internships and interns, it seems that usually they get,
content.trans: 好的。那么说一下实习和实习生，好像他们通常会得到……

content.text: it's not very exciting to become an intern because it ends up that the office people just make you,
content.trans: 成为实习生并不太令人兴奋，因为最终你只是被办公室的人安排去完成任务。

content.text: make coffee or copies and stuff like that. You're not really gaining much work experience.
content.trans: 你只是煮咖啡、复印文件而已，实际工作经验并没有多少提升。

content.text: That is the reputation in the United States for internships. So basically when you agree to do an
content.trans: 那是在美国关于实习的声誉。所以基本上当你同意去做的话，就是那个。

content.text: internship, sometimes you have to apply to do an internship. It's a very long process. You end up
content.trans: 实习，有时候你得申请才能去做实习。这是一个非常长的过程。最终你可能会发现，申请过程是相当漫长和复杂的一段旅程。

content.text: like you say making coffee for people or photocopying reports and this is really boring work.
content.trans: 确实，做咖啡给人们喝，复印报告这工作真的很无聊。

content.text: Right. I think that is the reputation that many places have, like you say in the United States,
content.trans: 好的。我认为这就是很多人所在的地方所拥有的声誉，就像你在美国所说的一样。

content.text: but also I don't know. I guess it does seem in a way the only opportunity in order to be able to
content.trans: 但我也说不清楚。我觉得这似乎就是唯一的机会，才能...

content.text: get into an industry or a company. Maybe it's a really good company, like I don't know, like
content.trans: 进入一个行业或公司。或许它是一个很好的公司，比如我还不知道，或者

content.text: Procter and Gamble. And how else are you going to be able to get in there with no job experience?
content.trans: 宝洁。你又有什么办法能进去没有工作经验呢？

content.text: Well, that's right. And a lot of people know that an internship doesn't really give you work
content.trans: 嗯，没错。很多人都知道实习并不给你真正的工作。

content.text: experience, but they still think that it gives you some edge or some advantage when you're looking
content.trans: 经验，但他们仍然认为这在你考虑的时候给你了一些优势或一些好处。

content.text: for jobs later because if I write down on my resume, we were talking earlier about resumes,
content.trans: 因为以后有工作，如果我在简历上写的话，我们之前讨论过简历的事情。

content.text: if I write down on my resume that I was an intern at Procter and Gamble, wow, that's really
content.trans: 如果我在简历上写自己在宝洁当过实习生，那真是太牛了！

content.text: impressive. Right. It looks good. All right. So this is an interesting topic. Let us know if you
content.trans: 确实很好。看起来不错。好的。所以这是一个有趣的话题。我们如果感兴趣的话，可以了解一下。

content.text: were ever an intern. Maybe you started out as an internship or maybe you're doing one now.
content.trans: 你曾经是一个实习生。可能是你是从实习开始的，也可能是你现在在做实习。

content.text: Was it better than we say? Did you do anything else other than making coffee? We really hope so,
content.trans: 你觉得我们说的更好吗？除了泡咖啡，你还做了什么？我们都希望是这样的。

content.text: and we look forward to hearing about your experiences. All right. We'll see everyone at englishpod.com
content.trans: 好的，我们期待听到你的经历。好的。我们会见每个人在英语Pod.com

content.text: and until next time. Bye.
content.trans: 和下次再见。
